plan.title: eRFX Technical + RFQ Requires a Project Title

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects for the test company.
Compose the required Technical and RFQ stages.
Apply a template to the Technical stage.
Apply a template to the RFQ stage.
Add the specified product line item.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the project is otherwise publishable.
Set the line item's delivery location to Plant Name.
Fill the required technical questionnaire responses.
Assign the required evaluator for the Technical stage.
Return to the RFQ stage for scheduling and participants.
Add the available QA test vendor audience.
